about.title: The path of harmony
about.p1: Aikido is one of the youngest martial arts in the world. Its philosophy emphasizes harmony rather than destruction. It is a system of non-resistance that enables effective self-defense without destructive techniques.
about.p2: Aikido is a martial system that allows you to control an opponent without causing harm. It is one of the most humane martial arts, while also requiring great control of one's own ego and psyche.
